name: Enrique Mateo Cobo
headline: I design and build things end to end — mechanics, electronics, firmware and software.
intro: I like starting from a blank sheet of graph paper and ending with something that moves, prints, or ships to the App Store.

stats.label: budget for a CoreXY printer built from scratch
iOS app shipped solo to the App Store

howIWork.title: From scratch
howIWork.text: Most projects start as a pencil sketch on graph paper, move into Fusion 360 CAD, and are then printed, wired and tested at my desk.

howIWork.title: Constraints as a feature
howIWork.text: The printer had a hard €120 budget, so I recycled and reused wherever I could and only bought what I truly needed.

howIWork.title: Iterate on failure
howIWork.text: The first printer frame was fully 3D-printed and flexed too much. I rebuilt it around aluminium extrusions. Learning by breaking is part of the process.

howIWork.title: Full stack, both worlds
howIWork.text: As comfortable with kinematics, steppers and G-code as with React Native, Node and a production backend.
